source_statement: For every natural width n, Gray labels below2^n and named little-endian n-bit functions are recursively bijective by G(n+1,2q+b)=(b xor(q mod2),G(n,q)), including n=0. The parity twist is an involution; arithmetic head function is defined on all natural indices and has even-flip/odd-fixed transitions. Every pair of consecutive bounded labels differs by exactly one named wire flip. No wraparound adjacency, selected closed-form target, physical operator/circuit/export or cost statement.
